reviews.decision: Complete ten-path patch read: CDK/Material tree overview references change, two childrenAccessor-based upstream demo components/templates and nested demo CSS are added, index exports and dev-app registrations expand. Dynamic expand icons, toggle/typeahead labels and nested outlet visibility are example behavior, not a tree/CDK implementation change. No public API, owned theme or legacy control changes occur. Examples/build registrations/overview guides are absent from both maintained closures. The doubled node/button toggle markup does not establish keyboard/event behavior qualification; current tree state and accessible interaction remain independently reviewable.

reviews.subject: feat(material-luxon-adapter): add option to set zone (#33579)
reviews.decision: Complete three-path patch read: production LuxonDateAdapter, its tests and datepicker guide add a timeZone option/setter, reject simultaneous useUtc+timeZone, separate LocaleOptions from DateTimeOptions, preserve clone input zone and apply configured zone to construction/parsing/deserialization. This is a production behavior/API change, not a docs-only patch. Neither maintained library imports, reexports, bundles or depends on material-luxon-adapter/Luxon, and no Luxon authored dependency use is enumerated. The owned LegacyNativeDateAdapter contract is a separate implementation. Do not adopt/fork this optional adapter or add its younger API/peer; source scope exclusion covers only those three unshipped adapter/guide paths. It does not certify arbitrary consumer-provided date adapters or current datepicker integration.
